    """For a row, identify 0-runs and classify them"""
    row = [int(x) for x in s.split()]

    i = 0
    while i < len(row):
        if row[i] == 0:
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(row) and row[j] == 0:
                j += 1
            
            # Check left neighbor (i-1) and right neighbor (j)
            left_nonzero = i > 0 and row[i-1] != 0
            right_nonzero = j < len(row) and row[j] != 0
            
            run_len = j - i
            becomes_8s = sum(1 for x in row[i:j] if x == 0)  # all zeros in run

                'left_2': left_nonzero,

                'length': run_len,
